ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forms an inverted V-shape originating from the peduncle and extending towards the median notch. High-intensity white pigmentation dominates the lateral lobes. Distinct low-intensity circular clusters are located at mid-right lobe and inner-left lobe regions. Low-intensity bordering is present along the trailing edge and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Distinct high-amplitude valleys (notches) are visible on the inner-left trailing edge and outer-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges tapering into sharp, posteriorly-oriented tips (flukes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary high-contrast dark circular clusters: one prominent singular spot on the right mid-lobe and a multi-pixel cluster on the left lobe adjacent to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark vertical linear marks visible near the distal tip of the right lobe and along the inner-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and missing segments on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical black-to-white transition boundary following the central fluke structure.
